title: RETRO 100 versus 65 Elo: historical stability audit
status: historical comparison, not independent new holdout
interpretation: 100 Elo has lower Brier and log loss than 65 in each of four historical evaluation seasons.
Because 100 was chosen after examining these seasons, this does not establish independent validation for adopting 100.
Neutral-site games receive zero explicit game-level home edge, but their predicted ratings depend on the training edge; neutral-site Brier worsened at 100 in all four seasons.
Keep live model unchanged pending independent prospective testing and venue validation.
next_tests: Run prospective 2026-27 predictions with 65 and 100 before results are known.
Validate source neutral/home flags and conference/postseason metadata before subgroup claims.
Compare paired game-level prediction losses with uncertainty intervals rather than relying only on aggregate seasonal scores.
